title: arachniodes lurida

This plant is native to the tropical and subtropical regions of East Asia and is traditionally used in herbal medicine. Arachniodes lurida has been reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its use in treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Arachniodes lurida include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are thought to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
